product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out TV Wall Mount for Portrait Displays Fits TVs 45in to 70in Max Weight 154 lbs Rotating Tilting with VESA up to 600x400
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out TV Wall Mount for Portrait Displays, Fits 45in-70in TVs, Max Weight 154 lbs, VESA up to 600x400The Monoprice Commercial Series Push-to-Pop-Out TV Wall Mount for Portrait Displays is a professional mounting solution for commercial video walls and digital signage where precise alignment and fast service access are required. Designed for portrait-oriented displays from 45in to 70in, it allows the screen to sit flush to the wall during operation and extend outward for maintenance without removal.This mount is engineered for AV installers supporting retail, corporate, control room, and hospitality environments where reliability, repeatable adjustment, and clean presentation matter.Push-to-pop-out mechanism provides rear access for cable management and maintenance without removing the displayFine micro-adjustment for height, depth, lateral position, rotation, and tilt (±3°) for precise portrait bezel alignmentSupports displays weighing up to 154 lbs (70 kg) and screen sizes from 45in to 70inHeavy-duty steel construction provides structural rigidity during adjustment and long-term stabilityWide VESA compatibility: 200x200, 200x400, 300x300, 400x400, and 400x600Retracts to a low-profile, flush position for clean video wall appearance when closedIndoor, professional installation only; regular inspection recommendedCompliant with RoHS, REACH, TSCA 6(h), EU POP, and California Prop 65 PUSH-TO-POP-OUT SERVICE ACCESSA spring-assisted push-to-pop-out mechanism allows the display to extend forward when pressed, providing rear access for cable management, maintenance, and alignment. When closed, the mount retracts to a low-profile position for a clean, flush appearance suitable for video walls. MICRO-ADJUSTMENT FOR PRECISE PORTRAIT VIDEO WALLSThe mount provides fine micro-adjustment for height, depth, lateral positioning, rotation, and tilt (±3°). These adjustments allow precise bezel alignment without removing the display, which is critical for multi-display portrait video wall installations. SUPPORTS LARGE, HEAVY COMMERCIAL DISPLAYSThe mount supports displays weighing up to 154 lbs (70 kg) and screen sizes from 45in to 70in. Heavy-duty steel construction provides structural rigidity during adjustment and long-term stability in commercial installations. WIDE VESA COMPATIBILITYCompatible VESA® (Video Electronics Standards Association) mounting patterns include 200x200, 200x400, 300x300, 400x400, and 400x600, covering a broad range of professional digital signage displays. DESIGNED FOR PROFESSIONAL INDOOR INSTALLATIONThis mount is intended for indoor use only and requires professional installation.
